question: Which three Indian jewellery retailers opened the most new stores in the last two years, and what is your evidence for each?
answer: I could not find a definitive ranking of actual new-store openings for September 14, 2024–September 14, 2026: the supplied evidence lacks comparable, complete gross-opening totals. Titan, Kalyan Jewellers and Malabar Gold & Diamonds are the strongest supported candidates among the retailers reviewed, based on reported network expansion rather than a verified openings ranking. Titan’s domestic jewellery network increased from 991 stores on September 30, 2024 to 1,227 on June 30, 2026—236 net additions. Kalyan’s group network, including Candere and overseas showrooms, increased from 303 to 524 over those same dates—221 net additions. For Malabar, India Ratings provides a clearer India-only comparison: 208 stores at the FY2023–24 baseline, 251 in FY2024–25 and 280 by March 25, 2026—72 net additions across that approximately two-year period. These figures have different geographic and brand coverage, and Malabar’s comparison uses different dates, so they should not be presented as an apples-to-apples ranking of new stores opened.

## Indian jewellery retailers: store expansion and new showroom openings

**Period reviewed: September 14, 2024–September 14, 2026.** Below is a comparison of **Kalyan Jewellers, Titan, Malabar Gold & Diamonds, Senco Gold and Joyalukkas**, focused on India, with international expansion identified separately.

**Important:** Store-network growth, gross new openings, renovations and announced expansion plans are different measures. The tables keep these distinctions visible; reporting dates also vary by company.

### 1. Store-network expansion

| Retailer | Earlier disclosed network | More recent disclosed network | Expansion indicated |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Kalyan Jewellers — group, including Candere and overseas** | **303 showrooms**, September 30, 2024 | **524 showrooms**, June 30, 2026 | **221 net additional showrooms**, approximately **73% growth** between these snapshots. In April–June 2026 alone, it opened **12 Kalyan and five Candere showrooms**. ([kalyanjewellers.net](https://www.kalyanjewellers.net/images/investors-new/pdf/shareholder-information/disclosures-to-stock-exchanges/2024-2025/29%20Press%20Release%20-%20Unaudited%20Financial%20Results%20for%20the%20Quarter%20and%20Half%20Year%20ended%20September%2030%202024.pdf?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Titan — domestic jewellery brands only** | **991 stores**, September 30, 2024: Tanishq 486, Mia 207, Zoya 12 and CaratLane 286 | **1,227 stores**, June 30, 2026, according to its July business update; includes beYon | **236 net additional stores**, approximately **24% growth**. The June-quarter update reported **33 net additions**: 22 across Tanishq/Mia/Zoya/beYon and 11 CaratLane. **Excludes watches, eyewear and international stores.** ([nsearchives.nseindia.com](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/TITAN_04022025175709_SEinvestorpresentationQ32024.pdf)) |
| **Malabar Gold & Diamonds — global** | **355 showrooms**, early September 2024 | Company website states **445+ showrooms across 14 countries**; September 2026 press coverage reported approximately **450** | Roughly **90–95 more locations** than the early-September-2024 benchmark. This is an approximate comparison of network disclosures, not a reconciled openings ledger. ([retail4growth.com](https://www.retail4growth.com/news/malabar-gold-diamonds-set-to-expand-global-footprint-with-20-new-showrooms-6880?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Senco Gold — reported network** | **166 showrooms**, September 2024 | **201 group showrooms**, March 2026, including 189 Senco Gold & Diamonds and 12 Sennes; **209 group showrooms**, June 2026 | Reported network increased by **43**, but the newer total explicitly includes Sennes, so this should **not** be presented as 43 additional conventional jewellery showrooms. April–June 2026 contributed **eight net group additions**. ([sencowebfiles.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com](https://sencowebfiles.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/website/files/dtEQDlyG0K2OZtsl7vDTRoIlvicnkK1rtoHt2dI4.pdf)) |
| **Joyalukkas — India business** | **98 showrooms**, December 31, 2024 | **116 showrooms**, March 31, 2026 | **18 net additional Indian showrooms** over this shorter, 15-month comparison. CRISIL states that the Indian business owns and operates its stores rather than using franchises. ([crisil.com](https://www.crisil.com/mnt/winshare/Ratings/RatingList/RatingDocs/JoyalukkasIndiaLimited_January%2024_%202025_RR_361580.html?utm_source=openai)) |

*Percentage changes are calculated from the cited store counts. These are the available dated snapshots—not exact opening counts for the full 24-month review period.*

### 2. Selected openings and expansion announcements

| Retailer | Date / period | Development | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Kalyan** | April–June 2026 | **12 Kalyan showrooms and five Candere stores** opened in India. | **Completed openings.** ([livemint.com](https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/kalyan-jewellers-india-share-price-jumps-over-36-in-three-days-buy-sell-or-hold-11783666796874.html?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Kalyan** | September 2026 | New **Mulund, Mumbai** showroom inaugurated, extending its Maharashtra presence. | **Completed opening**, reported September 11. ([artofjewellery.com](https://www.artofjewellery.com/NewsMore?id=1399&utm_source=openai)) |
| **Titan** | December 2025 | Entry into a new retail format with its first **beYon lab-grown-diamond store in Mumbai**. | **New brand/store launch**, distinct from Tanishq expansion. ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/sites/default/files/2025-12/SELGD.pdf)) |
| **Titan** | April–June 2026 | Domestic jewellery network expanded by **33 stores net**, including **11 CaratLane outlets**. | **Reported net additions**, not necessarily gross openings. ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/sites/default/files/2026-07/Q1update202627.pdf)) |
| **Malabar** | March 2025 | Announced **₹600 crore** investment for **12 Indian showrooms** by month-end, targeting a global network of 391. | **Announced rollout**; not treated here as independently verified completion of every location. ([economictimes.indiatimes.com](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/cons-products/fashion-/-cosmetics-/-jewellery/malabar-gold-diamonds-invests-rs-600-crore-to-open-12-new-showrooms-across-india-by-march-end/articleshow/119254783.cms?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Malabar** | September 2025 | Announced **48 showroom launches by December 2025**, comprising **27 new stores and 21 renovated stores**. The plan included **14 new Indian stores** and entry into New Zealand. | **Expansion plan. Only 27 were new locations—not 48.** ([uaenews247.com](https://uaenews247.com/2025/09/03/malabar-gold-diamonds-to-launch-48-showrooms-globally-27-new-21-revamped-showrooms-to-be-opened-by-december-2025/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Malabar** | March 2026 | Announced **₹1,580 crore** investment for **20 new Indian stores in 20 days**. Locations included Gurugram, Guwahati, Ranchi, Gwalior, Jamnagar and Bengaluru. | **Announced rollout**, targeting completion by March 31, 2026. ([retail.economictimes.indiatimes.com](https://retail.economictimes.indiatimes.com/amp/news/apparel-fashion/jewellery/malabar-gold-diamonds-to-invest-rs-1580-cr-to-open-20-stores-in-20-days-generate-over-725-jobs/129630316)) |
| **Senco** | April–June 2025 | Opened **nine jewellery showrooms**: company-operated stores at **Andheri Metro, Rourkela, Sonarpur and Bilaspur**; franchise-format stores at **Nagpur, Meerut, Dhupguri, Singur and Balichak**. A separate Sennes store opened in Patna. | **Completed openings**, disclosed by the company. ([sencowebfiles.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com](https://sencowebfiles.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/website/files/Aj2YKw4TYMKy3dnMUi8FOjZi6wuAcHGgPHAZs4zg.pdf)) |
| **Joyalukkas** | March 22, 2025 | Inaugurated its **Signature Jewellery Showroom on MG Road, Kochi**, with a dedicated bridal floor. | **Completed launch**; a flagship-format launch should not automatically be assumed to be a net addition. ([passionateinmarketing.com](https://www.passionateinmarketing.com/the-new-joyalukkas-signature-jewellery-showroom-with-exclusive-bridal-floor-in-kochi-now-open/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Joyalukkas** | October 11, 2025 | Opened a showroom in **Vaishali Nagar, Jaipur**, expanding its northern/western Indian presence. | **Completed opening**, confirmed by the brand’s inauguration coverage. ([youtube.com](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tAs8_6u2H0g&utm_source=openai)) |

### 3. What the comparison shows

- **Kalyan’s expansion is particularly rapid in percentage terms:** its combined Kalyan/Candere/global network grew approximately 73% between September 2024 and June 2026. This should not be confused with growth in Kalyan-branded Indian stores alone. ([kalyanjewellers.net](https://www.kalyanjewellers.net/images/investors-new/pdf/shareholder-information/disclosures-to-stock-exchanges/2024-2025/29%20Press%20Release%20-%20Unaudited%20Financial%20Results%20for%20the%20Quarter%20and%20Half%20Year%20ended%20September%2030%202024.pdf?utm_source=openai))
- **Titan’s expansion is spread across several formats.** Its domestic jewellery count includes Tanishq, Mia, Zoya, CaratLane and now beYon; comparing that total directly with another retailer’s large-format showrooms can be misleading. ([nsearchives.nseindia.com](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/TITAN_04022025175709_SEinvestorpresentationQ32024.pdf))
- **Malabar’s headline rollout numbers require adjustment for renovations.** Its 48-launch announcement contained only 27 new locations. ([uaenews247.com](https://uaenews247.com/2025/09/03/malabar-gold-diamonds-to-launch-48-showrooms-globally-27-new-21-revamped-showrooms-to-be-opened-by-december-2025/?utm_source=openai))
- **Senco is combining company-operated and franchise expansion**, while **Joyalukkas India remains company-owned/company-operated**. CRISIL’s April 2026 assessment recorded a plan for **10–15 additional Joyalukkas India stores in FY2027**—a forward plan, not completed openings. ([sencowebfiles.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com](https://sencowebfiles.s3.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com/website/files/Aj2YKw4TYMKy3dnMUi8FOjZi6wuAcHGgPHAZs4zg.pdf))

**Data limitation:** This is a sourced expansion overview and selected opening tracker, not an exhaustive city-by-city ledger. Public disclosures do not provide a consistently defined, exact 24-month gross-openings total across all five retailers.

## Kalyan Jewellers: latest investor-relations update
**As of September 14, 2026**

The latest annual report listed is **FY2025–26**, and the latest reported quarter is **Q1 FY2026–27, ended June 30, 2026**. Here are the official documents and key showroom updates. ([kalyanjewellers.net](https://www.kalyanjewellers.net/investors/annual-report/annual-reports.php))

### 1. Annual reports and quarterly results

| Document | Latest available / where to find it |
|---|---|
| **Annual reports** | FY2025–26 is the newest; FY2024–25 and earlier reports are also available on the official Annual Reports page. ([kalyanjewellers.net](https://www.kalyanjewellers.net/investors/annual-report/annual-reports.php)) |
| **Quarterly results** | Select **FY26–27 → Q1** on the official Quarterly Results page for financial results, presentations, business updates and earnings-call materials. ([kalyanjewellers.net](https://www.kalyanjewellers.net/investors/quarterly-results/quarterly-results.php)) |
| **Stock-exchange filings** | The official disclosures page includes the FY26 annual-report filing, Q1 FY27 business update and published financial-results extract. ([kalyanjewellers.net](https://www.kalyanjewellers.net/investors/shareholder-information/disclosures-to-stock-exchanges.php)) |

### 2. Latest financial performance

**Q1 FY27 results — released August 4, 2026:**

| Consolidated metric | Q1 FY27 | Year-on-year change |
|---|---:|---:|
| Revenue | **₹10,589 crore** | **+45.7%** |
| Profit after tax | **₹348.7 crore** | **+32.0%** |
| Basic EPS | **₹3.38** | ₹2.56 in Q1 FY26 |

Revenue was reported at approximately ₹10,589 crore; the official results extract confirms PAT and EPS above. ([ndtvprofit.com](https://www.ndtvprofit.com/markets/kalyan-jewellers-q1-results-profit-jumps-32-even-as-margins-contract-revenue-tops-rs-10-500-crore-11864360/?utm_source=openai))

For **FY2025–26**, consolidated revenue was **₹35,743 crore**, versus ₹25,045 crore in FY25. Consolidated PAT was approximately **₹1,350 crore**. Q4 FY26 revenue and PAT were approximately ₹10,275 crore and ₹410 crore, respectively. ([kalyanjewellers.net](https://www.kalyanjewellers.net/images/investors-new/pdf/shareholder-information/disclosures-to-stock-exchanges/2026-2027/Press%20Release%20for%20the%20quarter%20and%20year%20ended%2031st%20March%202026.pdf))

### 3. Showrooms: India, international and Candere

**Latest verified quarter-end network: June 30, 2026**

| Format / geography | March 31, 2026 | June 30, 2026 | Net increase |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Kalyan — India | 342 | **354** | **12** |
| Kalyan — Middle East | 38 | **38** | 0 |
| Kalyan — USA | 2 | **2** | 0 |
| Kalyan — UK | 1 | **1** | 0 |
| Candere — India | 124 | **129** | **5** |
| **Total** | **507** | **524** | **17** |

The company explicitly reported opening **12 Kalyan showrooms and five Candere showrooms in India during Q1 FY27**. International showroom counts were unchanged. These are June-end counts—not a live September total. ([kalyanjewellers.net](https://www.kalyanjewellers.net/images/investors-new/pdf/shareholder-information/disclosures-to-stock-exchanges/2026-2027/Q4%20Update.pdf))

For comparison, **Q4 FY26** saw **28 gross Kalyan India openings, but 24 net additions**, plus **14 Candere openings**. Gross openings should therefore not be confused with net network growth. ([kalyanjewellers.net](https://www.kalyanjewellers.net/images/investors-new/pdf/shareholder-information/disclosures-to-stock-exchanges/2026-2027/Q4%20Update.pdf))

### 4. More recent showroom openings

Selected openings reported after June 30 include:

- **Mulund, Mumbai — September 8, 2026:** a new Kalyan showroom and a Candere outlet were inaugurated. ([bollywoodhelpline.com](https://www.bollywoodhelpline.com/news/entertainment/others/malaika-arora-and-prabhu-ganesan-attend-kalyan-jewellers-showroom-inauguration-in-mulund/77030?utm_source=openai))
- **Rayagada, Odisha — September 8, 2026:** Kalyan opened its first showroom in the city. ([orozonejewelnews.in](https://www.orozonejewelnews.in/article?slug=sreeleela-inaugurates-kalyan-jewellers-first-showroom-in-rayagada&utm_source=openai))
- **Chennai — August 21, 2026:** the group opened the first flagship showroom of its separate regional brand, **ATM—Akshaya Thanga Maligai**. This is distinct from Kalyan and Candere formats. ([financialexpress.com](https://www.financialexpress.com/business/industry-kalyan-jewellers-bets-on-regional-brands-to-widen-buyer-base-4335506/lite/?utm_source=openai))

### 5. Candere and international trading update

The **July 7, 2026 preliminary Q1 update** reported:
- **Candere revenue growth:** approximately **112%** year on year.
- **International revenue growth:** approximately **35%**, including approximately **30%** in the Middle East.
- **India same-store sales growth:** approximately **28%**. ([kalyanjewellers.net](https://www.kalyanjewellers.net/images/investors-new/pdf/shareholder-information/disclosures-to-stock-exchanges/2026-2027/Quarterly%20Update_Q1FY26-27.pdf))

**Important comparison:** that preliminary update’s approximately **38% consolidated growth** referred to sales of goods **excluding bullion**. It is not the same measure as the approximately **46% reported revenue growth** in the August financial results. ([kalyanjewellers.net](https://www.kalyanjewellers.net/images/investors-new/pdf/shareholder-information/disclosures-to-stock-exchanges/2026-2027/Quarterly%20Update_Q1FY26-27.pdf))

## Titan Company: latest reports and jewellery-store additions
**As of September 14, 2026**

The latest annual report is **FY2025–26**, and the latest quarterly results are **Q1 FY2026–27**, covering April–June 2026 and announced on **August 7, 2026**. ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/investors/annual-reports))

### 1. Reports to use

| Document | Coverage / relevance |
|---|---|
| **FY2025–26 Integrated Annual Report** | Latest annual report, filed July 3, 2026; annual financials, jewellery strategy and brand commentary. ([financialfilings.com](https://financialfilings.com/filings/titan-company-limited/annual-report/2026/49033611/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **FY2024–25 Annual Report** | Previous-year comparison for jewellery performance and retail-network expansion. ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/sites/default/files/2025-07/Titan%20AR%202024-25%20%281%29%20%281%29.pdf?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Q1 FY27 results and earnings presentation** | Latest financial results; available in Titan’s official quarterly-results repository. ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/investors/quarterly-results)) |
| **Q1 FY27 business update — July 6, 2026** | Quarter-end store counts and preliminary operating growth. ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/sites/default/files/2026-07/Q1FY27%20Update.pdf)) |
| **Q1 FY27 earnings-call transcript** | Management commentary, including adjustments needed to interpret jewellery margins. ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/sites/default/files/2026-08/Q1FY27%20-%20Earnings%20Call%20transcript.pdf)) |

### 2. Jewellery-store additions by brand

**India only; net additions, not gross openings.**

| Quarter ended | Tanishq | Mia | Zoya* | CaratLane | Four-brand subtotal | beYon | Total jewellery additions |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| **September 2025 — Q2 FY26** | 6 | 18 | 0 | 10 | **34** | 0 | **34** |
| **December 2025 — Q3 FY26** | 10 | 11 | 1 | 24 | **46** | 1 | **47** |
| **March 2026 — Q4 FY26** | 8 | 14 | 0 | 5 | **27** | 0 | **27** |
| **June 2026 — Q1 FY27** | **4** | **17** | **0** | **11** | **32** | **1** | **33** |

Sources, respectively: Titan’s Q2 results, Q3 operating update, Q4 operating update and August 2026 results coverage. *Zero Zoya additions are inferred where the other disclosed brands fully reconcile to total net additions.* ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/sites/default/files/2025-11/Q2FY26%20Results.pdf))

**Latest quarter-end network:** Titan reported **1,227 domestic jewellery stores at June 30, 2026**, comprising **846 Tanishq/Mia/Zoya/beYon stores combined** and **381 CaratLane stores**. This compares with **1,194** domestic jewellery stores at March 31, 2026. These counts come from the operating updates. ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/sites/default/files/2026-07/Q1FY27%20Update.pdf))

**International expansion is separate:** Q1 FY27 results reported **two Tanishq store openings in the GCC**, outside the 33 domestic net additions. ([financialexpress.com](https://www.financialexpress.com/business/industry-titan-q1-net-profit-jumps-63-to-rs-1777-crore-revenue-rises-40-4313070/))

### 3. Latest quarterly financial results

**Q1 FY27; ₹ crore. Jewellery figures exclude bullion and digi-gold sales.**

| Metric | Q1 FY27 | YoY growth |
|---|---:|---:|
| Consolidated revenue from operations | **20,787** | **40.3%** |
| Consolidated profit after tax | **1,777** | **62.9%** |
| Total jewellery business income | **18,253** | **43%** |
| India jewellery business income | **16,943** | **38%** |
| Tanishq + Mia + Zoya, India | **15,502** | **38%** |
| CaratLane, India | **1,441** | **40%** |
| International jewellery business income | **1,309** | **136%** |

The latest results disclose Tanishq, Mia and Zoya **together**, rather than separate quarterly revenue for each brand. ([financialexpress.com](https://www.financialexpress.com/business/industry-titan-q1-net-profit-jumps-63-to-rs-1777-crore-revenue-rises-40-4313070/))

**Margin caveat:** Reported jewellery EBIT was **₹2,360 crore**, at **12.9%**. However, management identified **₹407 crore of customs-duty gains**, plus inventory mark-to-market benefits. After both adjustments, management put the **Tanishq/Mia/Zoya normalized EBIT margin at 10.9%**—a different scope from the total jewellery margin. ([economictimes.indiatimes.com](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/earnings/titan-q1-results-profit-soars-63-yoy-to-rs-1777-crore-total-income-surges-40/articleshow/133031183.cms))

### 4. Latest annual-report jewellery highlights

For **FY2025–26**, the annual report reports consolidated jewellery income, excluding bullion sales, of **₹67,602 crore**, up **34%**, and EBIT before exceptional items of **₹7,209 crore**, at a **10.7% margin**. Its brand commentary highlights Mia crossing **₹2,000 crore** in annual topline and Zoya reaching **13 exclusive boutiques**. ([financialfilings.com](https://financialfilings.com/filings/titan-company-limited/annual-report/2026/49033611/))

**Bottom line:** In the latest quarter, **Mia and CaratLane contributed 28 of the 33 net domestic jewellery-store additions**; Tanishq added four, beYon one, and no net Zoya addition was indicated. ([financialexpress.com](https://www.financialexpress.com/business/industry-titan-q1-net-profit-jumps-63-to-rs-1777-crore-revenue-rises-40-4313070/))

## Malabar Gold & Diamonds vs Joyalukkas: actual showroom expansion

**Checked as of September 14, 2026.** I’ve separated **operating showroom counts and completed openings** from expansion announcements. For the two-year comparison, I use **FY2024–25 and FY2025–26**, with earlier global-network snapshots and the latest update.

### 1. Latest total worldwide network

| Company | Latest company-stated network | Verification and qualification |
|---|---:|---|
| **Malabar Gold & Diamonds** | **450+ showrooms across 14 countries** | Stated on its current official website; independently reported by PTI/The Economic Times on **July 28, 2026**. This is an operating-network statement, not a future target. ([malabargoldanddiamonds.com](https://www.malabargoldanddiamonds.com/)) |
| **Joyalukkas** | **200+ showrooms**, according to its current official website | The website does not give a dated reconciliation of how it reached 200+. Dated reporting in April 2026 stated **190 showrooms across 12 countries**. Treat 200+ as the latest company claim, not an independently reconciled exact count. ([joyalukkas.in](https://www.joyalukkas.in/)) |

**Joyalukkas country-count discrepancy:** its Indian store pages now claim **13 countries**, while its international store locator still lists **12**. I would not present 13 as fully reconciled without confirmation of the additional operating market. ([joyalukkas.in](https://www.joyalukkas.in/stores/city/siddipet?utm_source=openai))

### 2. Previous two years: the clearest comparable actual expansion is India-only

These figures come from credit-rating disclosures. **Net network additions are not necessarily gross showroom openings**: closures, relocations and reclassifications can make the two differ.

| India network measure | Malabar Gold & Diamonds | Joyalukkas India |
|---|---:|---:|
| **FY2023–24 baseline** | **208** | **93, reconstructed*** |
| **FY2024–25 network** | **251** | **101*** |
| **FY2024–25 additions** | **+43 net**, calculated | **8 new showrooms explicitly reported** |
| **FY2025–26 latest year-end/near-year-end count** | **280 at March 25, 2026** | **116 at March 31, 2026** |
| **FY2025–26 net increase** | **+29 through March 25**, calculated | **+15**, calculated |
| **Two-year network increase** | **+72 through March 25, 2026** | **+23, reconstructed*** |

**Sources and limitations:**

- **Malabar:** India Ratings’ March 31, 2026 report explicitly gives **208 → 251 → 280**, with the last count dated **March 25**, not March 31. Thus, +29 should not be labelled a final full-FY2026 gross-opening total. ([indiaratings.co.in](https://www.indiaratings.co.in/pressrelease/y025h69u3l8y1mfyhplfgiyj/malabargold?utm_source=openai))
- **Joyalukkas:** ICRA reported **101 stores in February 2025**, including **eight added that fiscal year**. India Ratings subsequently confirmed eight FY2025 openings and **105 stores at August 31, 2025**, after four FY2026 additions. These disclosures imply the **93 → 101** bridge; the 93 baseline is reconstructed rather than directly quoted. CRISIL confirms **116 at March 31, 2026**. ([icra.in](https://www.icra.in/Rating/GetRationalReportFilePdf?Id=133570&utm_source=openai))

**Comparison:** on this disclosed India-network basis, Malabar’s approximately two-year increase was **72 stores versus Joyalukkas’s reconstructed 23**—about **3.1 times larger**, subject to the six-day cutoff difference. ([indiaratings.co.in](https://www.indiaratings.co.in/pressrelease/y025h69u3l8y1mfyhplfgiyj/malabargold?utm_source=openai))

### 3. Worldwide network progression—not annual opening totals

| Historical checkpoint | Malabar | Joyalukkas |
|---|---|---|
| **2024** | **355 showrooms**, September 6, 2024. ([financialexpress.com](https://www.financialexpress.com/business/industry-malabar-gold-amp-diamonds-to-launch-20-new-showrooms-across-india-gcc-countries-usa-3603422/lite/?utm_source=openai)) | **160+ showrooms**, reported October 2024. ([newsofbahrain.com](https://www.newsofbahrain.com/epaper/18-10-2024/PDF_18-10-2024_1729254695_1mPNM4ribv_18-10-2024.pdf?utm_source=openai)) |
| **2025** | **400th showroom actually opened in Noida**, reported June 2025. ([gulf-times.com](https://www.gulf-times.com/pdf/2025/06/24/main-20250624-1.pdf?ts=015521&utm_source=openai)) | **170 stores worldwide**, reported in 2025 by Business of Fashion. ([businessoffashion.com](https://www.businessoffashion.com/articles/global-markets/indian-jewellers-scaling-globally/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Latest checked in 2026** | **450+**, company-stated and corroborated by PTI. ([economictimes.indiatimes.com](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/cons-products/fashion-/-cosmetics-/-jewellery/m-s-dhoni-becomes-the-new-face-of-malabar-gold-diamonds/articleshow/132682277.cms?utm_source=openai)) | **200+**, current company-stated count; exact milestone date unverified. ([joyalukkas.in](https://www.joyalukkas.in/)) |

**Do not subtract these rounded, differently dated snapshots and call the result “actual annual openings.”**

### 4. Examples of completed openings

These are confirmed examples, **not an exhaustive opening register**.

| Company | Completed opening | Timing |
|---|---|---|
| Malabar | **Noida**, global showroom No. 400 | Reported June 2025. ([gulf-times.com](https://www.gulf-times.com/pdf/2025/06/24/main-20250624-1.pdf?ts=015521&utm_source=openai)) |
| Malabar | **Birmingham and Southall, UK — two showrooms** | Reported September 2025. ([arabtimesonline.com](https://www.arabtimesonline.com/arabtimes/uploads/images/2025/09/09/87135.pdf?utm_source=openai)) |
| Malabar | **Santa Clara, California**, bringing its US network to eight | Reported July 2, 2026. ([indiapost.com](https://indiapost.com/malabar-gold-diamonds-continues-its-expansion-in-north-america-launches-8th-showroom-at-santa-clara-california/?utm_source=openai)) |
| Joyalukkas | **Al Mankhool, Dubai** | Opened April 6, 2025. ([linkedin.com](https://www.linkedin.com/posts/joyalukkas_joyalukkas-mankhool-newbeginnings-activity-7314967858617159681-Ayxf?utm_source=openai)) |
| Joyalukkas | **Sydney and Melbourne, Australia — two showrooms** | Inaugurated April 11 and 12, 2026. ([youtube.com](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N_oKOxIC0cw&utm_source=openai)) |
| Joyalukkas | **Iselin, New Jersey**, its eighth US showroom | Opened July 11, 2026. ([theindianeye.com](https://theindianeye.com/2026/07/18/joyalukkas-strengthens-us-footprint-with-8th-showroom-in-iselin-new-jersey/?utm_source=openai)) |

**Counting caution:** Joyalukkas’s June 2026 Chromepet and Kanchipuram events were explicitly advertised as **re-openings**, so they should not automatically count as two incremental stores. ([youtube.com](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0zParhbRYZw&utm_source=openai))

### Bottom line

- **Latest worldwide headline:** Malabar **450+**; Joyalukkas **200+ company-stated**. ([malabargoldanddiamonds.com](https://www.malabargoldanddiamonds.com/))
- **Best-supported two-year India expansion:** Malabar **+43 then +29 through March 25, 2026**; Joyalukkas **eight reported openings then +15 calculated net additions**. ([indiaratings.co.in](https://www.indiaratings.co.in/pressrelease/y025h69u3l8y1mfyhplfgiyj/malabargold?utm_source=openai))
- **Remaining gap:** I found operating-network disclosures and individual completed-opening reports, but **not a fully reconciled worldwide gross-opening total for each company for each of the two financial years**. Expansion targets should not be substituted for that missing actual-opening data.

retrieval.query: Senco Gold PNG Jewellers Thangamayil latest annual reports new stores opened showroom network additions
retrieval.text:
## Latest annual reports: store openings and showroom additions

**As of September 14, 2026, the latest available annual reports for all three companies are FY2025–26**, covering the year ended **March 31, 2026**. “PNG Jewellers” here means **P N Gadgil Jewellers Ltd (PNGJL)**. ([financialfilings.com](https://financialfilings.com/filings/senco-gold-limited/annual-report/2026/51023471/))

### FY2025–26 comparison

| Company | New stores / additions reported for FY26 | Network at March 31, 2026 | Important distinction |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| **Senco Gold** | **26 net additions**, according to the annual report’s management discussion | **201 group showrooms**: 102 domestic company-owned, 85 franchise, 12 Sennes and 2 Dubai | The **189 Senco jewellery showrooms already include Dubai**; adding 12 Sennes gives 201. The report also records closure of 2 company-owned stores. ([financialfilings.com](https://financialfilings.com/filings/senco-gold-limited/annual-report/2026/51023471/)) |
| **PNG Jewellers** | **25 new stores**; **12 opened in Q4 alone** | **78 stores**: 77 India + 1 USA | Q4 additions comprised **8 company-owned/company-operated (COCO)** and **4 franchise-owned/company-operated (FOCO)** stores, including LiteStyle formats. ([nsearchives.nseindia.com](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/PNGJEWELLERS_22052026190110_IntimationofTranscript.pdf)) |
| **Thangamayil Jewellery** | **10 outlets opened**, according to the directors’ report | **66 branches**, versus **60** at March 31, 2025 | **Gross openings were 10, but net network growth was 6**. These should not be treated as the same metric. The annual-report table lists 58 leased-property and 8 owned-property branches. ([economictimes.indiatimes.com](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/thangamayil-jewellery-ltd/directorsreport/companyid-30963.cms)) |

### Where the expansion happened

- **Senco:** Named additions include **Nagpur, Bikaner, Bettiah, Meerut, Etawah, Hazaribagh and Ambikapur**, plus several West Bengal locations. The annual report indicates a **FY27 target of 18–20 additional showrooms**, with greater emphasis on franchises. ([financialfilings.com](https://financialfilings.com/filings/senco-gold-limited/annual-report/2026/51023471/))
- **PNG:** FY26 expansion included entry into **Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh and Bihar**, alongside further Maharashtra expansion. Q4 openings included **Gorakhpur and Varanasi/Banaras**. Its year-end business update targeted **25 additional stores in FY27**, taking the network to **103**; this is guidance, not completed openings. ([cdn.shopify.com](https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0730/2578/1979/files/Press_Release_Q4_FY_25-26.pdf?v=1779281805))
- **Thangamayil:** Expansion focused on **Chennai and surrounding markets**. The directors’ report planned **at least nine outlets in FY27**, with the second expansion phase targeted for completion by **December 31, 2026**. I could not reconcile the difference between its 10 reported openings and six net additions from the passages available, so I would not assume four closures without further disclosure. ([economictimes.indiatimes.com](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/thangamayil-jewellery-ltd/directorsreport/companyid-30963.cms))

### Annual-report sources

- **Senco Gold:** FY2025–26 annual report, filed **August 7, 2026**; see *“Showrooms Spreadsheet”* and *“Our Business Is Growing.”* ([financialfilings.com](https://financialfilings.com/filings/senco-gold-limited/annual-report/2026/51023471/))
- **PNG Jewellers:** FY2025–26 annual report is listed on its investor page; the shareholder communication is dated **September 5, 2026**. The full report PDF did not load reliably, so the operating figures above were cross-checked against the company’s FY26 results release and earnings-call transcript. ([pngjewellers.com](https://www.pngjewellers.com/pages/investors))
- **Thangamayil:** **26th Annual Report 2025–26**; see printed **page 10** for branch counts and the directors’ report section *“Expansion of Retail Outlets.”* ([thangamayil.com](https://www.thangamayil.com/corporate/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/26th-Annual-Report-2025-2026.pdf))

**For a spreadsheet, keep separate columns for “gross openings,” “net additions,” and “closing network.”** In particular, Senco’s 26 is explicitly described as **net additions**, while Thangamayil’s 10 is **outlets opened**. ([financialfilings.com](https://financialfilings.com/filings/senco-gold-limited/annual-report/2026/51023471/))

trace.answer: I could not find a definitive ranking of actual new-store openings for September 14, 2024–September 14, 2026: the supplied evidence lacks comparable, complete gross-opening totals. Titan, Kalyan Jewellers and Malabar Gold & Diamonds are the strongest supported candidates among the retailers reviewed, based on reported network expansion rather than a verified openings ranking. Titan’s domestic jewellery network increased from 991 stores on September 30, 2024 to 1,227 on June 30, 2026—236 net additions. Kalyan’s group network, including Candere and overseas showrooms, increased from 303 to 524 over those same dates—221 net additions. For Malabar, India Ratings provides a clearer India-only comparison: 208 stores at the FY2023–24 baseline, 251 in FY2024–25 and 280 by March 25, 2026—72 net additions across that approximately two-year period. These figures have different geographic and brand coverage, and Malabar’s comparison uses different dates, so they should not be presented as an apples-to-apples ranking of new stores opened.
